goal: Make the Pi skill package reproducible from a clean Git checkout by tracking its required skills/BASELINE.md source copy instead of relying on an ignored local generated file.

acceptance.assertion: plugins/immune-brain/skills/BASELINE.md is a Git-tracked, non-ignored regular package source file; it remains byte-identical to plugins/immune-brain/BASELINE.md and plugins/immune-brain/dist/BASELINE.md; the focused BASELINE packaging contract passes from both the working tree and a checkout-index isolated copy without generation or waiver.
